source_units.text: Draft first-use screen copy for an imaginary appliance.
Its intended audience: new owners of the imaginary Pebble Press.
These invented details are required: The fictional Pebble Press stamps decorative cards.
First place one blank card in the tray, then choose a pattern.
Its first-use screen should explain that the sample print uses the selected pattern and invite the user to start.
Include each of these exact strings: "Pebble Press", "place one blank card", "choose a pattern".
Keep the tone friendly and concise.
The full text must be between 50 and 80 words.
